tests_repair.diagnosis: Ties are ordered alphabetically, not by first appearance, and only surrounding punctuation is stripped, so hyphenated words stay whole. Fixed both expectations.

A.rationale: words.count(word) rescans the whole list for every distinct word, O(n·k). Counter counts in one C-level pass; the same sort key then gives the identical ordered dict.

B.rationale: Counts each word as it is read instead of calling list.count per distinct word, so the work is linear. The filtering, ranking key and returned dict are unchanged.

C.strategy: List comprehensions for the split pass
C.rationale: Conservative micro-optimization: builds the word list with comprehensions and a local punctuation table. The counting step is untouched, so the result is identical.
